description: Quote the connected account's exact Gold price for the tavern menu workflow: create a tavern menu lettered with tavernName and dishes (one dish and its price per line, up to four), optionally from an owned tavern image. Returns gold_cost, affordable and quote_token without starting a run, moderating, charging Gold or consuming a free sheet. After the user approves the price, call chargen_run_recipe_tavern_menu with the same values and quote_token. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_tavern_menu.

values.description: Workflow inputs. Quote and run with identical values.

sourceImageId.description: Owned still image UUID from chargen_search_gallery
